name: mattiasthalen
description: Mattias Thalén's personal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: design-and-build
plugins.description: Design interview in plan mode, then an approved plan carrying the brief, then capture, build, review and PR. Depends on the design and agent-skills plugins.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Tobias Karlsson's design plugin: interview-driven software design taking a rough pitch to a complete, gap-free design tree, captured as specs, contracts and ADRs, with a lexicon and assumptions record across a project's lifetime.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Addy Osmani's agent-skills: production-grade engineering skills covering spec, plan, build, verify, review and ship. design-and-build's builder uses its test-driven-development and incremental-implementation skills.
